# Skylight Village Jaj - Official Entity Information

> Skylight Village is a premier mountain campsite, wooden cabin lodging, and day picnic sanctuary located 1,200 meters above sea level in Jaj, Jbeil District, Mount Lebanon, Lebanon.

## Core Contact & Location
- **Mobile Hotline & WhatsApp**: +961 70 66 33 99 (Direct WhatsApp Chat: https://wa.me/96170663399)
- **Google Maps Location**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/v3TU1HqX9YGE1hSSA
- **Official Website**: https://skylightvillagelb.com
- **Digital Menu**: https://menu.skylightvillagelb.com/
- **Social Media**: https://instagram.com/skylightvillagelb | https://www.facebook.com/Skylightvillage/

## Core Services & Lodging Options
- **Land Rent (Bring Your Own Tent)**: $6 / person / night. Access to clean restrooms, mountain spring water taps, electricity, and central campfire.
- **Full Setup Tent Package**: $8 / person / night. Pre-erected tent setup prior to arrival.
- **Full Comfort Tent Package**: $12 / person / night. Pre-erected tent equipped with foam mattresses and sleeping bedding.
- **Scout & Youth Group Camping**: $3 / person / night. Dedicated Small Section (20+ guests) and Large Section (50+ guests) with assembly fields and campfire spaces.
- **Day Picnic Setup Pass**: $3 / person / day. Shaded pine trees, 1 chair per guest, 1 table per 4 guests, spring water, clean restrooms, and electricity.
- **Octagonal Wooden Cabins**: $35 / unit / night. Solid wood A-frame structure, insulated walls, real mattress beds, and interior electric outlets.

## Gear & Equipment Rentals On Site
- **Table & 4-Chair Rental Bundle**: $10 / day.
- **BBQ Grill Rental + Charcoal**: $10 / day.
- **Medium Firewood Box**: $7 / box.
- **Outdoor Hammock Rental**: $5 / day.
- **Extra Folding Chairs**: $3 / chair.

## On-Site Dining & Restaurant
- Traditional Lebanese Cold & Hot Mezza (Hummus, Tabbouleh, Moutabbal, French Fries).
- Charcoal-grilled Shish Taouk, Kebabs, and Kafta.
- Ice-cold Almaza beer, juices, and freshly squeezed lemonade.
- Fresh clay-head Shisha delivered directly to picnic and dining tables.

## Location & Transportation
- **Address**: Mount Lebanon Heights, Jaj Village, Jbeil District, Mount Lebanon, Lebanon.
- **Coordinates**: 34.1500° N, 35.7833° E
- **Altitude**: 1,200 meters above sea level.
- **Driving Time**: 30-35 minutes from Byblos (Jbeil) via Annaya road. 60 minutes from Beirut.
- **Road Condition**: 100% asphalt-paved road accessible by all sedans, compact cars, and buses.

## Key Nearby Attractions
- **Jaj Cedar Reserve**: 10 minutes drive (6km trail round trip, ancient Phoenician cedar forest at 1,500m).
- **Historic Mar Abda Chapel**: 10 minutes drive.
- **St. Charbel Monastery in Annaya**: 15 minutes drive.
- **Byblos Old Souk & Citadel**: 30 minutes drive.
